FLASHCARD · ALPHABET OBJECT CARDS · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Juice Object Card — the Letter J Picture (J is for Juice)

Just the juice — no letters next to it. Cover the card, reveal it slowly and play “what could this be?” — then say the real word together.

Draw on this card: pick a crayon under the picture, write or color right on the card with a finger, a stylus or the mouse, then tap “Save my work” to keep a copy. Nothing is uploaded anywhere — the drawing stays on your device.

← Ice creamPrevious cardKite →Next card

Say it together

“J is for juice. Juh — juice! More juice, please.”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the letter, the word, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Guessing first, naming after. Whatever the guess is, take it — “a moon!” “a banana!” — then say the real word together and move on while it is still a game.
